notes.title: Steam Deck verified!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Footgunner, [/h2]

Have you always wanted to explore the Underground, kick some upgraded balls into your enemies, and try to defeat all the bosses - all while being on the go? 

Well, now you can do it in the best way possible! 
[b]Footgun: Underground is officially verified for playing on the Steam Deck.[/b] 

So grab your high-tech handheld PC and enjoy some adrenaline-kicking runs while traveling, going to school/work or chilling on the couch. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/cce659d59426d0a8b30083747d0c43e899d0acb7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Footgun: Underground – Steam Deck Verified & Now on Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
Exciting news, footgun fans! Footgun: Underground is now Steam Deck Verified, meaning you can enjoy the game seamlessly on your Deck! 🏆🔥

Even better: Footgun: Underground is now available on Nintendo Switch! 🚀⚽

To celebrate this milestone, we’re offering shortly limted discounts:
💥 40% off on Steam
💥 20% launch discount on Nintendo Switch

Grab your copy now and show off your skills – whether on PC, Steam Deck, or Switch! 🏆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/a4dcb37771974563b4d4d38cb949844ccb69326d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1.1
notes.content:
- Added Steam Controller text input support.
- Introduced a new character, Mr. Titan Tanner, for the "Not Even Close" achievement.
- All characters now start with a double jump.
- Fixed shop train overlapping with other interactions.

notes.title: DevGAMM Lisbon 2024 and new bundle!
notes.content:
Greetings Footgunner, 

Once again we have some great news to share with you! 

First of all, we are again part of a great event showcasing a bunch of fantastic games from other studios - it's the [b]DevGAMM Lisbon[/b] Southern Europe Game Festival! 

Until November 20th you can browse a variety of discounted and upcoming games: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/DevgammLisbon24


The other great news is that we released a bundle with the Roguelike "Mori Carta"
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1570830/Mori_Carta/ 

So if you want a swiping Roguelike instead of a kicking one, get the bundle for a discount! 
Or gift it to a Roguelike fan you know! 

That's it for now, but keep your eyes peeled as we're preparing some other great things for the future ;)

notes.title: Let's kick it to the PixElated Adventures event!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Footgunners,[/h2]
[h3]Are you also a fan of great pixel games like us? (Probably yes, since you're reading this post 😁)  
We're happy to announce that Footgun: Underground is part of the [b]awesome PixElated Adventures event[/b], running from [b]29 July to 5 August[/b]. [/h3]

The event consists of: 
[list]
[*] [b]a Steam Event page with lots of discounts[/b]
[*][b] a Reddit AMA with developers [/b]
[*] [b]an art contest to showcase your creations on the event page for millions to see[/b]
[/list]
So in a week, if you want to fill your cart with a selection of great pixel games or recommend Footgun to a friend, check out the Steam event page or visit the website for more information: http://www.pixelatedfest.com/  

Many thanks to BraveAtNight for organizing this event and to you for keeping the ball rolling in Footgun: Underground!

notes.title: Kick-Off Update + Games Baked in Germany Event!
notes.content:
Greetings Footgunners,

The European Championship has started and if you're as captivated as we are, you'll surely enjoy our latest "Kick-Off" update for Footgun: Underground!

We're releasing [b]6 new characters[/b] for even more football action! If you want to further improve your skills and smash enemies with your football-gun skills, this is for you!

And if the timing wasn't perfect enough, we are participating in the [b]Games Baked in Germany Event[/b] with a [b]juicy discount[/b] - ideal if you want your friends to try out the game! 

Come take a look at the free update and lead your team to victory (or at least out of the Underground)!

notes.title: Gamescom latam 2024 - let's kick some balls in Brazil!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Footgunner, [/h3]

As we continue to improve the game so you can have a kick-ass time with it, we have some fantastic news to announce! 

[b]Footgun: Underground is nominated for the gamescom latam awards in the category "Innovation"![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif[/img]

(Fire the laser- ehh fireworks)


The entire team is excited and honored to be recognized by such an important event. 
If you plan on attending the event in Brazil, you can check out our game station and show off your mad ball skills to the visitors. 

Well, that's it - short and sweet! 
We'll let you know if we take home the trophy and until then - congratulations to all the other nominees and thank you for joining us on our ballsy journey with Footgun! 

P.S.: We'll soon have some exciting game-related news to share, so stay tuned!

notes.title: DCP Nominee
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/3795afa2e557e897b440baf061420728689cb9dc.jpg[/img]

Greetings Footgunner,

We’re excited to be nominated for the German Computer Game Award (DCP), Germany’s most significant gaming award, hosted by Germany’s Federal Government and the German Games Industry Association ‘game'! We’re competing in the category “Best Prototype” and we’re eagerly awaiting the award ceremony on April 18, 2024. 

We’ll keep our fingers and toes crossed – how cool would it be if we take home the most prestigious German videogame award?! 

#roguelikewithballs

notes.title: This roguelike has you batter mutants with ricocheting footballs
notes.content:
I've never been a true "Football Enjoyer". I'll weirdly get into it at certain times, like when the World Cup is on and I get suckered into the belief that, "It's actually coming home this time". But maybe I could be a football enjoyer, now that there's a roguelike out there that combines football skills with room-clearing. I'd give Footgun Underground's demo at least 90 minutes of your time.
